title: Event, publication, observation and knowledge times
summary: Single Time Service v0.3 is the conversion authority. LibrarianTimeAdapter produces normalized instants annotated with timezone and tzdb edition. LibrarianTimedIndex filters by publication and observation cutoffs; event time and the time knowledge became available are distinct. Future interfaces must model intervals, uncertain instants, disputed dates and timezone data versioning without ad-hoc string timestamp comparison.
invariants: Never infer local timezone from current host settings.
Historical as-of evaluation must exclude claims not published or not observed at its respective cutoff.
Correction and retraction histories must remain reconstructible; later observations do not retroactively alter historical knowledge.
Time Services may evolve: bind to verified semantic API; do not build a competing time service in Librarian.

provenance.claim: Time adapter, observation and knowledge cutoff implementation.
